## About
G&J Carcare is an auto repair shop at 1401 E St Georges Ave in Roselle, near Warinanco Park. We describe our approach as "Old World" craftsmanship paired with the latest training, information and technology.
Our ASE certified technicians work on American and foreign vehicles, including Chevy, Ford, Toyota, Honda, Nissan and Lexus. We use current diagnostics equipment, and everything done to your car is explained to you in layman's terms. We also handle fleet maintenance and repair.
One reviewer called George when her car started overheating on the way to work. It turned out to need a new water pump, and he repaired it that day.

## Services
- State inspection: Inspections, plus repairs as an emission repair facility.
- Brakes and rotors: Brake service and repairs, rotors, ABS lights and ABS system work.
- Cooling system service: Radiator and cooling system service for cars and trucks before a small problem turns into a breakdown.
- Tire sales, mounting and balancing: New tires sold, mounted and balanced at the shop.
- Drivability diagnostics: If your car isn't running right, we track down the cause before we fix it.
- Air conditioning service and repairs: Service and repairs for your car's air conditioning.
- Fleet maintenance: Maintenance and repair for business fleets.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: American and foreign vehicles, including Chevy, Ford, Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Lexus and more.

Q: Do your repairs come with a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer a 12-month/12,000-mile warranty on all parts and labor.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We are open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
